title: FairLangProc: A Python package for fairness in NLP

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated in the case study using the Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT) to measure semantic associations between male/female terms and math/arts concepts. Also measured in methodological examples using Log-Probability Bias Score (LPBS) for masked gendered pronouns and counterfactual word pair substitutions.

Measured using the Categorical Bias Score (CBS) to compute the variance of predicted probabilities for masked racial tokens (e.g., 'white', 'black', 'asian'), and through WEAT to compare associations of European American and African American names.
Evaluated using variance-based probability metrics (such as CBS) designed for non-binary demographic attributes, as well as modular debiasing techniques (MoDDiffy) targeting religious identity terms.
